Landing.title: Your shop window has value.
Landing.subtitle: MiVitrina connects shops with a window to advertisers looking for physical ad space — no upfront cost, no risk.
Landing.trustNoUpfrontDesc: Shop owners never pay anything to lend out their space.
Landing.trustVerifiedDesc: Every shop is verified before it can publish a listing.
Landing.trustSecurePaymentDesc: Funds are held online until the poster is actually put up.
Landing.galleryTitle: Concerts, shows, fashion, retail — every poster finds its window
Landing.gallerySubtitle: MiVitrina isn't limited to one industry: any poster can go up in any partner window.
Landing.heroImageAlt: A shop window seen from the street, with an advertising poster
Landing.galleryPoster2Alt: Silhouette of an actress on stage behind a red curtain
Landing.stepsCommercant1Desc: Photos, available size, rate — in a few minutes from your dashboard.
Landing.stepsCommercant2Desc: Payment is secured online before the poster is even put up.
Landing.stepsCommercant3Title: You put it up, you get paid
Landing.stepsCommercant3Desc: A confirmed installation photo is all it takes to trigger your payout.
Landing.stepsAnnonceur1Desc: Search available shop windows near your audience, across Spain.
Landing.stepsAnnonceur2Desc: Pick a duration, send your poster, pay with full security.
Landing.stepsAnnonceur3Desc: The shop owner confirms installation, then removal, each backed by a photo.
Landing.featuresTitle: A platform that protects both sides
Landing.featureGeoDesc: Find available shop windows near you, across Spain.
Landing.featurePaymentDesc: Processed by Stripe, released only at the right point in the rental cycle.
Landing.featureVerificationDesc: Every shop is verified before it can publish a listing.
Landing.featurePhotoDesc: Installation and removal of the poster are both confirmed with a photo.
Landing.featureChatDesc: Talk directly without ever having to share your personal details.
Landing.featureCommissionDesc: One clear rate, applied only to bookings that are actually paid.
Landing.finalCtaSubtitle: Create your account in a few minutes — it's free, no commitment.
